encounter: E0152 TRAINER_HEIDI, Route 111 ace (Grass core with Shaymin), cap 42
availability_audit: Chronology: Heidi stands on Route 111 immediately after the Heat Badge, at the very start of the cap-42 window (C23 raised the cap; C24 is the Ashen Woods rescue, C26 is the desert). Every member's source gate is 30 or lower and every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Petalburg Woods (C05), Seaspray Cave (early, gate 14), Dewford Manor (C11-C14), Mauville Game Corner (C18). Nothing from later in the cap-42 window is used - no Mirage Tower or desert (C26), no Meteor Falls fishing, no Ember Path, no Jagged Pass gate-42 species, no legendary, no Surf (C27), no Strength area.
plan: Hard type answer to a three-Grass team. Every member hits Grass for at least 2x, and five of the six are immune to Mudsdale's Ground attacks by typing or Levitate. Crobat's Taunt is the specific answer to Parasect - it shuts off Spore, Leech Seed and Lurantis's Synthesis in one move. Weavile is the Ice answer that also handles Mudsdale, which the Fire/Flying core cannot. Charizard, Talonflame and Weavile all threaten Parasect at 4x or 2x.
